author: IGN
description:
Take a first glimpse of an ambitious new chapter for RuneScape: a fourth RuneScape MMO, built for a new generation of players. Still early in development, the as-yet-unnamed title will bring the world of Gielinor to life in Unreal Engine, combining the depth, freedom and community-led spirit that have defined RuneScape for 25 years with the technology and game design possibilities of today.

title: RuneScape - Official 4th MMO Teaser Trailer

author: IGN
description:
Check out the announcement trailer for RuneScape Reignited! 25 years in the making, RuneScape Reignited launches December 2, marking a defining moment for the game — inviting players old and new to return together, rediscover RuneScape and experience it as it was always meant to be. Through the Remastered Journey and Adventure Guide, alongside a fresh economy, brand-new hi scores and a focus on player first. Reignited gives players the ultimate RuneScape experience.

Check out the Arkaya Skill Overview Trailer for Monster Hunter Outlanders, a mobile iteration of the hit open-world monster-hunting RPG developed by TiMi Studio Group. Arkaya wields a stalwart lance that builds resolve through a steady stream of attacks. Some skills consume all Resolve to power a devastating blow while granting a massive shield. Monster Hunter Outlanders launches on October 29 on iOS and Android.

author: IGN
description: It's wild to challenge the titans of it like League of Legends and Dota 2. However, key developers on March of Giants also worked on another game you'd think was challenging immovable competition—Rainbow Six Siege, which in many ways went up against tactical shooter titan Counter-Strike and has survived and thrived to this day. From what I saw, March of Giants is playing some of the same cards as Siege did, including one key decision: While it plans to incorporate the accessibility you expect from a game made in this decade, March of Giants doesn't dilute the genre. It has the hardcore things that have survived and thrived in the MOBA for years—from big stuff like separate skill leveling and complex itemization to the littler things like last hitting.
title: March of Giants Might Actually Get You to Play a MOBA Besides Dota 2 and League | IGN Preview

author: IGN
description:
Take a look at the October Update 1.72 trailer, part of the Spec IV Part 1 for Gran Turismo 7, the hit racing simulation game developed by Polyphony Digital. Players can enjoy new content with the latest 1.72 update, packed with 6 new cars, including the Citroën 2CV 6 Charleston (1986), Ferrari F355 Berlinetta (1994), Honda Step WGN Spada Premium Line (2023), and the Mazda RX-VISION GT3 EVO (2026). Also as part of the update, race through the Sportsland SUGO Circuit and enjoy a new "Car Concierge" service for ordering used and legend cars, and many more features. The October Update 1.72 will be available for free beginning October 14.

#ign #gaming
title: Gran Turismo 7 - Official October Update 1.72 Trailer
